people.name: Azaniah
people.line: One of the Levites who sealed the covenant

people.name: Bani
people.line: A Levite who taught the Law and led prayers.

people.name: Henadad
people.line: A Levite whose sons assisted in rebuilding the temple.

people.name: Jeshua
people.line: A prominent Levite leader during the post-exilic period.

people.name: Kadmiel
people.line: A Levite who returned from Babylonian exile

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites
